name: Nutrition & Dietetics
title: Nutrition and Dietetics
intro: The dietitian route: eligibility, course, clinical internship and registration.

phases.title: Class 11–12 prerequisites
phases.summary: Science with Biology and Chemistry is preferred.
points: Most colleges require Class 12 Science (PCB).
Some institutes accept other streams with biology or home science.
Minimum marks are usually 50%.
Basic cooking and health awareness is helpful.

phases.title: Admission process
phases.summary: CUET-UG or merit at universities and colleges.
points: Apply through the university or college portal.
CUET-UG is used by some universities for BSc Nutrition.
Check colleges with hospital tie-ups for dietetic internships.
Complete admission formalities.

phases.title: Three to four years of study
phases.summary: Biochemistry, human nutrition, clinical nutrition and food science.
points: Year 1: Human Physiology, Biochemistry, Food Science and Basic Nutrition.
Year 2: Normal and Therapeutic Nutrition, Community Nutrition, Food Microbiology.
Year 3: Clinical Dietetics, Nutrition in Disease, Food Service Management and Research Methods.
Year 4 (where offered): Advanced dietetics, dissertation and extended internship.

phases.title: Dietetic internship
points: Complete a supervised internship of about six months in a hospital dietetics department.
Plan diets for inpatients, outpatients and special conditions.
Practice counselling and case documentation.
This is required to become a registered dietitian.

phases.title: Registration, MSc and careers
phases.summary: Register as a dietitian and choose a specialisation.
points: Register with the Indian Dietetic Association (IDA) and take its registration exam where applicable.
MSc Nutrition or Dietetics and sports nutrition courses.
Jobs: hospital dietitian, community nutritionist, food industry and fitness industry.
Private practice and online counselling are growing options.
